{{ModBox}}
'''Meticulous Aim''' is a [[Weapon Augments#Weapon Augment Mods|Weapon Augment Mod]] for {{Weapon|Vulkar}} and {{Weapon|Vulkar Wraith}} that increases [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] damage at the cost of decreased bodyshot damage.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Headshot Damage
! Bodyshot Damage
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || +17.5% || -7.5% || 4
|-
| 1 || +35% || -15% || 5
|-
| 2 || +52.5% || -22.5% || 6
|-
| 3 || +70% || -30% || 7
|-
| 4 || +87.5% || -37.5% || 8
|-
| 5 || +105% || -45% || 9
|}

==Acquisition==
* Available for {{Nc|20}} from the [[Nightwave#Cred%20Offerings|Nightwave Cred Offerings]] store on a rotational basis.
* Meticulous Aim was originally acquired by reaching Rank 23 in [[Nightwave]] during [[Nightwave/Series 2|Series 2: The Emissary]], and again by reaching Rank 14 during [[Intermission III]].
** Beginning with [[Nightwave/Amir's Shockwave|Nightwave: Amir's Shockwave]], it was added to the Nightwave Cred Offerings.

==Notes==
*Calculated ''additively'' with {{Weapon|Vulkar}}'s headshot zoom bonus, which then calculated ''multiplicatively'' with weapon overall damage.
**At max level of zoom with Meticulous Aim equipped, the weapon benefits from a total of '''70 + 105 = 175%''' headshot damage bonus.
**Despite the differing descriptions, it stacks with {{M|Target Acquired}} for up to '''70 + 60 + 105 = 235%''' headshot damage bonus.
*Bodyshot damage penalty is multiplicative to weapon overall damage.
**For example, using Vulkar modded with a {{M|Serration}} and a maxed rank Meticulous Aim will reduce body shot damage from '''(225 × (1 + 1.65) = 596.25''' to''' (225 × (1 + 1.65) × (1 - 0.45)) = 327.93'''.
**"Bodyshot" means anything but a headshot, including limbs or parts that might have higher damage multipliers such as [[MOA]] backpacks.
*The '''-45%''' bodyshot damage is always applied ''twice'' to {{D|Slash}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Toxin}}, and {{D|Blast}}, but will not apply to {{D|Electricity}} or {{D|Gas}} if they are from a headshot.
*Both bonus damage and damage penalty still apply whether [[zoom]]ing while firing or not.

'''Miter Incarnon Genesis''' is an item that is used to add [[Incarnon]] upgrades to the {{Weapon|Miter}}.

==Acquisition==
*Upon completion of [[The Duviri Paradox]] and [[Angels of the Zariman]], and unlocking [[The Steel Path]], players can earn {{Resource|Miter Incarnon Genesis}} from [[The Circuit]]'s Steel Path to place on their Miter with the help of [[Cavalero]] in the [[Chrysalith]]. This [[Incarnon Genesis]] form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
*Purchased from Cavalero for {{pc|120}}, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made '''once'''.

==Incarnon Genesis==

*Installing the Miter Incarnon Genesis requires 20 {{Resource|Pathos Clamp|Pathos Clamps}}, 60 {{Resource|Rune Marrow}} and 60 {{Resource|Tasoma Extract}}.
**When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 [[affinity]] to the weapon, affected by [[Affinity Booster]]s.

===Overview===
*Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving [[Enemy Body Parts|weakpoint hits]] and then pressing the [[Alternate Fire]] button. '''4''' weakpoints hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
**Charges '''do''' generate when hitting weak points highlighted by {{A|Sonar}} or {{M|Detect Vulnerability}}. 
***However, they do not generate from hits on {{A|Crystallize}}'s crystalline growths.
**Weakpoints on corpses or [[Invulnerable]] targets do '''not''' build charges.
**Individual [[Multishot]] bullets can build charges.
*Mode switching is '''not''' instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's [[reload speed]].
*Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
*Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Miter's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing '''5''' rounds to a maximum of '''20'''. Once all ammunition is expended, the Miter reverts to its normal form.
**Incarnon Form's magazine is '''not''' affected by mods.
**Incarnon Form is '''not''' affected by [[Ammo Efficiency]] (such as {{A|Energized Munitions}}).
**Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, [[bleedout]], or being [[disarm]]ed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon [[death]].
